label: pjm 56 cc committed
definition: pjm 56 CC inframarginal lift on pjm-55 keeper. CC_REGULAR committed 0.6624->0.75, econ_low 0.78->0.92 (less artificial self-schedule discount; offer baseload/low-econ CC nearer true full-load HR). Raises PJM LMP in low-price hours to close the over-export spread to MISO/NYISO and open the SERC import spread — the lift scales with gas price so it cools dear-gas 2025 (the worst miss) most. econ_high/peak and all coal sigmoids/structural levers pjm-55 verbatim.
